verdict.rationale: Bevy provides migration guides for each release (bevy-docs-15) but is explicitly pre-1.0 with breaking API changes every release (bevy-probe-rt-1), and hands-on community reports confirm real breaking-change pain across upgrades (bevy-comm-12, bevy-comm-13) — the opposite of a stable, documented deprecation policy an AI agent could rely on. Missing for 10: a formal semver/deprecation policy document, stability guarantees for APIs, and evidence that deprecated APIs are marked/warned before removal rather than simply broken.
